quote: I would come back voluntarily one more evening to see what Day 2 does with the secrets I kept, but only if the game tells me who I am talking to and what I said. I would not leave it running.

Yes, another evening, but only if I can actually ask one person about another and see on screen why someone refuses or keeps something private. The eight-versus-ten crates are the kind of thing I like to check, and I never got to check them.
If the dead clicks stay silent and only the record explains them, I would lose patience within a session.
I would not leave it running in the background, because the clock moves and I want to read carefully.
I would come back another evening on the laptop, and I would open How to play first.
Let me choose who I repeat a secret to and what I say. On the phone I tapped "Repeat this at another table", and the game picked Dilan and the claim "Derya is not kind" for me.

Show refusals and "not now" answers next to the button, with a reason. Ece said "This person cannot do this now. Try again later." with no reason. On desktop, Rıza's refusal of "Press for private details" appeared only in the Garden record.
Give me a decision or an action while the garden is empty from about 8:00, or a pace that skips that stretch. Fast was about one game minute per real second on desktop.
Show where and when bread and produce get ordered, and what a private-keeping or gossip choice earns or costs. I never found an order control in about 3 minutes on each device.
Shorten the Garden record, which is a long wall of text. Remove off-topic lines such as Derya's Day 4 supply text.
Make the Who? and What? choices work, and show what a claim did. Selecting a person failed on both devices, and claims produced no visible reply.
Show the cost of "Press for private details" on Osman. The clock moved two minutes and nothing visibly changed.
Make the "Talk about someone else" lists work, and show that it is a folded heading, not a button. On the desktop my choice in the "Who?" list timed out.
Put How to play in the Game menu. Either open the Garden record by default or bring its key lines (Day 4 supplies, Day 8 cooking, the crate count) to the front.
On the phone, keep the selected person's panel and the Who?/What choices next to the people grid.
